Pricing.metaDescription: Clear, affordable pricing for home help in Edmonton. Pay per visit or choose a monthly membership with 4 or 8 visits.
Pricing.title: Membership and pricing
Pricing.lead: Choose what suits your family. Every plan includes the same friendly, reliable help.
Pricing.currencyNote: Prices are in Canadian dollars. No tax is added at checkout.
Pricing.manage: Already a member? Manage my membership
Pricing.empty: Our plans are being updated. Please call us for current pricing.

visit.a: A visit is one trip to the home, up to the time included in your plan, for the tasks we agreed on together. Longer or larger jobs are quoted separately before we start.

cancel.a: Yes, at any time and with no fee. Your membership stays active until the end of the month you have already paid for, then stops.

unused.q: What happens to visits I don't use?
unused.a: Visits are for the current month and don't carry over. If something comes up, call us and we'll do our best to reschedule within the month.

area.q: Do you come to my area?
area.a: We serve Edmonton, St. Albert, Sherwood Park, surrounding communities and acreages. If you're not sure, ask and we'll tell you.

pay.a: Monthly memberships are paid by card online and renew automatically each month. Per-visit and custom-quote services are arranged directly with us.

medical.q: Do you provide medical or personal care?
medical.a: No. We provide non-medical, non-emergency help only. We don't offer nursing, personal care or emergency response.

About.metaDescription: Mabel Home Help offers friendly, affordable, non-medical help so seniors can stay comfortable at home and families can worry less.
About.title: A friendly hand with everyday life
About.lead: Mabel Home Help exists for a simple reason: small jobs shouldn't stand between someone and the home they love.
About.illustrationAlt: A helper and an older man sharing coffee at a kitchen table
About.story1: For many seniors, it isn't the big things that make staying at home hard. It's the bins on a snowy morning, the driveway after a storm, the trip to the pharmacy, or simply a week without a good conversation.
About.story2: We provide affordable, friendly, non-medical assistance to seniors, people with disabilities and families who need extra help with everyday tasks. We show up when we say we will, we do the job properly, and we treat every home with respect.
About.story3: And because the people who worry most are often far away, we can update family members after each visit, with the client's permission.

reliable.title: Reliable
reliable.body: We arrive when we say we will. If plans change, you hear from us first.

friendly.title: Friendly

affordable.title: Affordable
affordable.body: Clear prices agreed before we start. No contracts and no surprises.

About.ctaBody: A short call is all it takes to get started.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Mabel Home Help respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect through this website, why we collect it and what we do with it. We follow Alberta's Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA).

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
When you send a request, a message or a sponsorship inquiry, we collect the details you give us: your name, phone number, email address, the service and area you are interested in, and anything you write in the message.

When you buy a membership, we also collect the name and phone number of the person receiving visits, the service address and any notes you add.

We do not ask for medical or health information. Please do not include it in any form.

use.title: Why we collect it
use.body: We use your information only to respond to you, to arrange and provide services, to manage memberships and billing, and to keep records we are required to keep. We do not sell your information or use it for advertising.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Membership payments are processed by Stripe. Your card details are entered on Stripe's secure pages and are never seen or stored by us. We keep only a reference to your Stripe customer record, your plan and your billing status. Stripe's privacy policy explains how Stripe handles your information.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: We share information only with service providers that help us run this website and our business, such as our hosting, database, email and payment providers, and only as needed for those purposes. Some of these providers may store information outside Canada. We may also disclose information when the law requires it.

family.title: Updates to family members
family.body: We share updates about visits with family members only with the client's permission.

retain.title: How long we keep it
retain.body: We keep requests and inquiries for up to 24 months and then delete or anonymise them. We keep membership and billing records for as long as tax and accounting rules require.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: This website uses only the cookies it needs to work, such as remembering your language. We use privacy-friendly analytics that do not use cookies and do not identify you.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Contact us using the details on our Contact page and we will respond within a reasonable time.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: If you have a question or a concern about your privacy, please contact us. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may contact the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Alberta.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use this website or buy a membership from Mabel Home Help. Please read them carefully.

scope.title: What we provide
scope.body: We provide non-medical, non-emergency help with everyday tasks. We do not provide nursing, personal care or emergency response. In an emergency, call 911.

requests.title: Requests and bookings
requests.body: Sending a request through this website does not create a confirmed booking. A service is confirmed only once we have contacted you and agreed on the tasks, the timing and the price.

membership.title: Monthly memberships
membership.body: A membership includes the number of visits shown for your plan each month. A visit is one trip to the home for the agreed tasks, up to the time included in your plan. Visits that are not used in a month do not carry over to the next month.

billing.title: Billing and renewal
billing.body: Memberships are billed in advance, in Canadian dollars, to the card you provide. Your membership renews automatically each month on the same day until you cancel. If a payment fails, we will contact you and may pause visits until it is resolved.

cancel.title: Cancellation and refunds
cancel.body: You can cancel at any time using the Manage my membership link or by contacting us. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the month you have already paid for. We do not refund part of a month. If we are unable to provide your visits, we will make it right with a credit or a refund.

changes.title: Price changes
changes.body: If the price of your plan changes, we will tell you before the change applies to you. You can cancel before the new price takes effect.

conduct.title: Safety and respect
conduct.body: We may decline or stop a service if a task is unsafe, outside the scope of what we provide, or if our helpers are not treated with respect. Roadside assistance is limited, non-emergency help for monthly members and depends on safety and availability.

liability.title: Our responsibility
liability.body: We take care in everything we do. To the extent the law allows, our responsibility for any loss is limited to the amount you paid us for the service concerned. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Alberta consumer protection law.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Alberta and the laws of Canada that apply there.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms? Please contact us using the details on our Contact page.

Emails.footer: Mabel Home Help provides non-medical, non-emergency services only.
